blocks.text: NAGA CITY, Camarines Sur — The Naga City General Hospital has added beds along its hallways as dengue cases in the city reached about 600 as of Sept. 17. The city government ordered the placement of additional beds at the hospital to accommodate a possible surge in dengue patients as the hospital’s wards reached full
